title: The Gourmet Supremos: Breakthrough Thinking
description: Xudong, the leader of the Gourmet Supremos, seems to be troubled by a certain matter...

mainQuestExcel.title: The Gourmet Supremos: Breakthrough Thinking
mainQuestExcel.description: Xudong, the leader of the Gourmet Supremos, seems to be troubled by a certain matter...

dialogs.text: Hey, Traveler. Nice to see you again.
Anything that I can help you with?
Remember how I promised you a meal? I'm making preparations for it right now.
We've been collecting fresh ingredients from everywhere to make a great meal.
I've almost got enough ingredients, so I'm trying to figure out how to cook them.
Where are Julie and Parvaneh?
Well, Parvaneh is out tracking down more ingredients for the "ultimate seasoning" that she wanted to make.
She took Julie outdoors with her on that search... They said they wouldn't go too far from town, though, so don't worry.
However, I do need your help with something. Although I have a lot of fresh ingredients, I don't have... the inspiration I need to make a breakthrough.
Look at these. Seagrass... Sea Ganoderma, and... uh, Sakura Bloom...
They are quite fresh, but I have no idea where to start.
I was going to ask a local chef in Inazuma for advice. But if I did that, I'd end up with the usual Inazuma cuisine. It's nothing new.
So I thought of using Inazuman ingredients like the chefs from Liyue. That way, I might be able to make something new and exciting.
Traveler, could you please go to Liyue and consult Chef Mao of the Wanmin Restaurant for me?
Leave it to me.
Thanks. I'll be waiting for you here.
I hope Chef Mao has some good ideas...
You want that bit of boom shaka-laka, don't you?
Boom shaka-laka? What? Do you mean... a kind of feeling of awe from food?
If you can find a recipe with that feeling, that would be fantastic.
But I don't know anyone who would have such a recipe...
Anyway, please go and consult Chef Mao for me first.
Are you going to treat me to that meal?
Hahaha, that's exactly what I'm prepping for!
Huh? Traveler, what are you doing here? Want me to whip something tasty up again?
I'm actually here for your advice...
Xudong went to Inazuma to cook?... He really has quite a bit of determination.
Do you know him?
Sort of. We had a cooking rivalry once, and it was... a stalemate.
He said he wanted to travel the world looking for a breakthrough... I never thought he would actually do it.
Still, it looks like he's hit a wall...
Do you know what might help him?
I can't guarantee it will work, but I'll try my best.
Seagrass... Sea Ganoderma... and... Sakura Bloom? These are strange ingredients...
If I took the Seagrass and Sea Ganoderma alone, I think I could make a dish... but we'll need some additional things.
Traveler, could you please go and find some Jueyun Chili and Fowl for me?
No problem.
Thanks. Bring them to me once you get them.
Ah, classic ingredients...
Hahaha, that's for sure. They are the hardest to mess up too. Bring them to me once you get some.
That said, I really don't know how to cook Sakura Blooms... I'm not sure how chefs in Inazuma handle them.
Perhaps Xiangling knows how to solve his problem...
Xiangling... True, she's always been a very creative cook. Maybe she can figure out a solution.
But she's gone to Qingce Village to pick bamboo shoots at the moment, so she isn't here. It'll take a while to find her.
Xudong must be waiting anxiously. Let me see if I can solve his problem.
I sure hope Chef Mao has some good ideas...

flow.stepDescription: Give the Jueyun Chili and Fowl to Chef Mao

dialogs.text: Have you gotten the Jueyun Chili and Fowl?
That should be enough. Hold on a moment. I'll see what I can do with these ingredients...
Done. Still, I feel like it's not all that different from the dishes I usually make...
Take this dish back to Xudong. Hopefully, it'll solve his problem...
Oh, you're back. What did Chef Mao say?
These bamboo shoots look pretty good. I'll dig some up...
Huh? It's you. What brings you here? Want me to whip something tasty up again?
Well, I've got something I need your help with.
Oh. Handling ingredients from Inazuma using techniques from Liyue...
Hehe. You've come to the right chef! I've heard of an Inazuman technique where you wrap ingredients in flour and fry them.
It's called tempura and it's served with a special dipping sauce.
I was particularly interested in the dipping sauce when I tried making tempura.
I've tried so many ingredients: Whopperflower Nectar, Flaming Flower...
Is it made with Slime Condensate, by any chance?
No, no. Slime Condensate isn't appropriate for this dish.
Still, I prefer adding the powder from Electro Cicin wings to give it a more layered texture.
Just in case you forget, I'll write it down. Then you can show it to Xudong.
*sigh* I wish I could go to Inazuma. There must be so many ingredients I haven't used yet.
You reacted just like Chef Mao...
Oh, you went to the restaurant? Hmm. But now that I've had another look, you don't look like you're here for a meal.
Are you having some culinary problems, then?
I sure hope Chef Mao has some good ideas...
Oh, you're back. What did Chef Mao say?
This dish... let me give it a try...
The taste is great and the combination of the ingredients is also really good. As expected of Chef Mao.
However, I still feel like it's missing a little something...
The boom shaka-laka feeling, I suppose.
I don't know... *sigh* I'll think about it. At least Chef Mao has given me an idea.
Thank you for your help. Please take these.
How on earth am I going to make a truly unique dish...
Xiangling... wrote this? It must have been hard to find her. Thank you for your help.
Let's see... Whopperflower Nectar... Flaming Flower... and Electro Cicin wing powder...
Rather... unexpected, I must say.
I'll look into this... In the meantime, please take these as thanks.
Ahem... I better read these notes and put them away quickly. I can't let Parvaneh find them...

questNarration.text: Wanmin Restaurant... Paimon remembers that name. That's the restaurant Xiangling and her father run, right?
